groups.title: Questions and answers
groups.lede: The first screens an agent learned. Each is one line of text from the agent; each tap goes back to it as an event.

entries.title: ask
entries.what: A yes or no question with big buttons.

entries.title: choose
entries.what: One answer from a few, with a type-your-own escape hatch.

entries.title: pick
entries.what: Several answers at once, with a cap and a Done button.
entries.yl: pick "What gear do you have?" Dumbbells|Bench|Bands|"Pull-up bar"|Kettlebell +other max=3

entries.title: slide
entries.what: A number on a scale, with words at each end.

entries.title: form
entries.what: A few fields in one card: text, sliders, switches, choices.
entries.yl: form "Daily check-in" mood:1-5 "Trained today":yes split:Push|Pull|Legs submit="Log it"

entries.title: list
entries.what: A checklist the person ticks off as they go.

entries.title: timer
entries.what: Intervals, rounds and rest. A workout timer opens full screen.

entries.title: card
entries.what: A picture, a title, a line of detail and one button.
entries.yl: card "Leg day" "Squat, RDL, walking lunges. About 45 minutes." sub="Thursday" img=/yl/legday.svg cta="Start workout"

entries.title: table
entries.what: Rows and columns, sortable, with units.

entries.title: camera
entries.what: Asks for a photo. The picture goes to the agent.

entries.title: mic
entries.what: Asks for a voice note. Drawn on the web today; the app gets it with voice (YUI-14).

groups.title: Pictures and video
groups.lede: For anyone who works with images: pick the best shots, compare an edit, review a cut, plan a reel.

entries.title: image
entries.what: One picture. With +edit, the person circles what to change.

entries.title: gallery
entries.what: A grid, row, feed or coverflow of photos. Tap to open, or pick favorites.

entries.title: video
entries.what: A clip to watch, loop or approve.

entries.title: compare
entries.what: Before and after: a slider, side by side, or tap to flip, with the changes marked.

entries.title: storyboard
entries.what: Frames of a video or post, in order. Drag to reorder, comment on any one.

groups.title: Numbers, charts and science
groups.lede: For tracking progress and for learning: charts drawn from data, big numbers, equations, and calculators you can drag.

entries.title: stat
entries.what: A big number with its change and a sparkline.

entries.title: chart
entries.what: Line, bar, area, scatter, pie and donut, from numbers in the line or a live table.
entries.yl:
say "Down 2.3 pounds this week, right on plan."
stat 178.9lb Weight delta=-2.3 spark=181.2|180.6|179.8|178.9 good=down sub="this week"
chart line "Weight" x=Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu y=180|179|178.5|178.9 y2=180|179.5|179|178.5 names=Actual|Plan unit=lb

entries.title: math
entries.what: Typeset equations, from one line of TeX.

entries.title: step
entries.what: A derivation or a protocol, one step at a time, with timers where needed.

entries.title: calc
entries.what: A formula with sliders. Drag a value and the answer and chart follow.
entries.yl: calc "How far does it fly?" f="R = v^2*sin(2*a)/g" v=5-40@20m/s a=0-90@30deg g=9.81m/s^2 plot=a unit=m

groups.title: Lessons and plans
groups.lede: Screens that hold other screens: a deck of pages, a plan that asks one thing at a time, a walkthrough read aloud.

entries.title: deck
entries.what: Pages to swipe through, with a quiz at the end.

entries.title: plan
entries.what: Plan mode: one question at a time, ending in a project card that reopens it.

entries.title: narrate
entries.what: A walkthrough the agent reads aloud, frame by frame.

groups.title: The app around the screens
groups.lede: Everything here is a real capture from the iPhone simulator.

entries.title: First run
entries.what: From sign-in to your agent's first screen, with nothing to guess.

entries.title: Connect your agent
entries.what: Three commands on your computer and a pairing code. Your agent dials out; your machine opens no ports.

entries.title: Your agent answers with screens
entries.what: Each agent gets a thread, and a short guide that teaches it every screen above.

entries.title: Your agents, your list
entries.what: Add, rename and remove agents yourself. The top button opens the list.

entries.title: A look for every agent
entries.what: Coral wordmark, letter avatars, light and dark, and a theme per agent that the agent can change with one line.

entries.title: Full screen when it matters
entries.what: Workouts take the whole phone. Swipe down and a pill keeps the timer running in the chat.

entries.title: Timer on the lock screen
entries.what: A running timer keeps counting on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island, in the agent's look. Pause, resume or end it without opening the app.

entries.title: Change your answer
entries.what: Tap again to change a choice; the agent hears changed: true. It can lock one on purpose with +lock.

entries.title: Pictures in, photos out
entries.what: Agents send images and videos they make; you send photos from your camera roll.

entries.title: A buzz when your agent answers
entries.what: A push when the app is closed, none while you are watching the thread, and a mute switch per agent.

entries.title: Pick it up in Yui
entries.what: From Telegram, "send it to Yui" drops the screen into that agent's thread and pushes it to your phone.

entries.title: React to a message
entries.what: Hold a message from your agent and pick one of six. Each is an instruction: 👍 build it, 👎 no, 🤔 ask me, ❤️ keep it, ⏳ later, 🔥 do it next.

entries.title: Jump to the newest message
entries.what: Scrolled up a long thread: a round arrow above the composer counts the agent's new messages and takes you back down in one tap.

entries.title: Nothing gets lost
entries.what: Messages wait for a sleeping Mac or a dropped network, with a clear mark when they land. History is kept 90 days, with limits that keep the service safe for strangers.

entries.title: Sign in, try the demo, get help
entries.what: Sign in with Apple, delete your account in the app, a demo code for reviewers, and help one tap away.

groups.title: Yui Lines on yuigui.com
groups.lede: The screen language, shown where people land: one line and the screen it draws on the home page, and a five-line quick start on the spec.

entries.title: Five lines, five screens
entries.what: The quick start at the top of /yl. Tap a line to draw it; the app draws the same line the same way.

groups.title: Planned, not built
groups.lede: What these cards will look like, drawn by the web renderer from Yui Lines that parse today. None of this is in the app yet.

entries.title: Voice in, text out
entries.what: Talk, read the answer. The mic screen is drawn on the web; on-device speech in the app is not built.

entries.title: Onboarding interview
entries.what: A first-run interview that suggests your first agents.

entries.title: Meal photo to macros
entries.what: Snap a plate, get an estimate, log it to a table on the phone.

entries.title: More than one screen per agent
entries.what: Agent-controlled screens beside the chat, and named screens reopened in two tokens.
